conclusion: Kernarg offsets, alignment, hidden arguments, and reserved holes are part of the ABI and must be materialized exactly.
decision: Pack by recorded byte offsets and preserve all unassigned bytes; never compact visible arguments.
invalidated_assumptions: Only visible pointer arguments need to be copied into a launch buffer.
observation: The tracked kernels use 280/288-byte kernarg segments with hidden u32/u16/u64 fields and non-contiguous offsets.
question_or_symptom: A compact host argument list would silently move hidden fields and change the kernel ABI.
